definitions.explanation: A line made up of connected straight segments that change direction at each point. Most commonly encountered in the term {折|お}れ{線|せん}グラフ (line graph).

examples.japanese: {折|お}れ{線|せん}⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{折|お}れ{線|せん}⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表|あらわ}した→表す：01868_arawasu⟧。
examples.english: I showed the temperature changes in a line graph.

examples.japanese: {折|お}れ{線|せん}⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Looking at the line graph, you can see that sales have been increasing year by year.

notes:
Most commonly used in the compound {折|お}れ{線|せん}⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧ (line graph), which is one of the basic graph types taught in Japanese elementary school math. The literal meaning is 'bent line' or 'broken line.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {折|お}れ{線|せん}⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧: line graph
- {折|お}れ{線|せん}⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to show with a line graph
- {折|お}れ{線|せん}⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{取|と}る→読み取る：04602_yomitoru⟧: to read a line graph

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{直線|ちょくせん}→直線：05440_chokusen⟧: straight line — a line without any bends
- ⟦{曲線|きょくせん}→曲線：05441_kyokusen⟧: curve — a smoothly curved line
- ⟦{棒|ぼう}グラフ→棒グラフ：20688_bougurafu⟧: bar graph — another common graph type
- ⟦{円|えん}グラフ→円グラフ：19567_engurafu⟧: pie chart — another common graph type

USAGE:
In Japanese math education, students learn the four basic graph types: {折|お}れ{線|せん}⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧ (line graph), ⟦{棒|ぼう}グラフ→棒グラフ：20688_bougurafu⟧ (bar graph), ⟦{円|えん}グラフ→円グラフ：19567_engurafu⟧ (pie chart), and ⟦{帯|おび}→帯：02610_obi⟧⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧ (stacked bar chart).
